campaign.title: Gallery of D*ck Pics station domination
campaign.evidence: The OAAA case study says Plenty of Fish’s “Gallery of D*ck Pics” campaign ran in NYC from May 8 through June 6, 2023, using a major transit domination with signage on turnstiles, stairways, walkways and digital screens. It identifies the activation as a Manhattan subway station; OUTFRONT’s campaign coverage identifies that station as Broadway-Lafayette, where the ads occupied the station. The supplied station list’s exact name is Broadway-Lafayette St/Bleecker St.
